svg.aria-label: BitaKit architecture: your pages use @bitakit/ui to bind actions in headless Core; your plugins and optional BitaKit plugins share Core services, actions, events, settings, slots, configs, overrides and interceptors; discovery and the framework adapter generate imports and types at build time.
